title: The Protocol of the DMZ
author: Oscar Halloran
blurb: Jude Iversen, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
